note: In Franconia Notch beside the Franconia Notch Recreational Trail, with the Falling Waters and Old Bridle Path trailheads through the tunnel under the parkway. Wooded sites; only about 15 of the 97 are rated for a vehicle of 23 ft or more, all on the inner loops, and the river row along the Pemigewasset is tent and pop-up sites. No pets. Cannon Mountain RV Park, further up the notch, takes bigger rigs. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 97 sites (7 first-come: 37, 93-98), no hookups, coin showers, lodge store, $35, max 28 ft from RA per-site lengths; season written as year-round with the full-service late May-mid Oct window (RA/agency say primitive camping the rest of the year); waterfront riverfront should come down: the 11 RA 'Riverfront' sites are all tent (10 ft) or pop-up (16-19 ft) sites; note rewritten.
flags: Waterfront: riverfront -> not waterfront suggested (no --AWH value). RA tags 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront' on 11 sites, 045, 047, 050, 052, 055, 057, 059, 060, 062, 064, 066 (the south row on the map, e.g. 052 at 44.14228,-71.68452; 066 at 44.14111,-71.68540), and every one is a 'Tent Only' (Max Vehicle Length 10 ft) or 'Pop-up/Tent' (16-19 ft) site, so a 23-ft rig can't use any of them; they are sold by the night (reservable). The sites that take 23 ft+ (Standard, 24-28 ft: 001, 027, 031, 032, 034-038, 040, 043, 072 among them) sit on the inner loops, the nearest (043 at 44.14253,-71.68482) about 50-60 m from the river behind the riverside row and its loop road. Esri imagery (44.1424,-71.6846) is continuous canopy: the river is hidden under the trees, so it is under ~20-30 m wide here (creekside at most even for the tent row). Suggested waterfront_evidence: 'RA per-site Proximity to Water=Riverfront on 11 sites (045-066 south row), all Tent Only 10 ft / Pop-up 16-19 ft; 23-ft-capable Standard sites are on the inner loops ~50-60 m back behind the row and loop road; Esri canopy-blind, channel hidden under canopy (<30 m). Not waterfront for a 23-ft rig (2026-11-23).'

Rig length: only about 15 of 97 sites take 23 ft or more by RA's per-site Max Vehicle Length (from a full scrape of all 97 per-site pages: 24 ft x9, 25-26 ft x1, 28 ft x5; 22 ft x5, 21 x1, 19 x36, 18 x1, 17 x7, 16 x3, 12 x3, 10 x21, none x4 platforms). The site lengths vary, so they are not a placeholder. nhstateparks.org calls all 97 'wooded tent sites', but RA sells the long Standard sites with 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' or 'RV'. Keep; no criteria problem.
